verdict.rationale: ReadMe is a SaaS documentation platform with several AI features (Agent, Ask AI, AI Linter, GitHub AI Writer), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions any training opt-out, data-use policy, or control that stops customer content from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
